scope: Informed nonauthor exact necessary filter; Port10, w=(17t,B,22t,D)>0, 1935 directions, exact optimizer and strict 3/2 near-set; binary homogeneous linear tree. Not full lower-bound or Native Review.
method: Generate exact integer representatives for all 4249 antipodal sign classes; clip all actual connected active components separately. For a crossing endpoint inside a segment, its q-sign is forced when the endpoint signs agree weakly with at least one strict. Retain all actual clipped components and count each support once per sign; if either first child has >31 supports, or every second query forces >15 distinct supports to some strict child, depth six impossible. A zero test cannot help; it leaves the first child unchanged. This improves the exterior-endpoint-only static necessary filter without filling gaps. Nonzero signs on endpoints extend to nearby actual active interval points, and every retained necessary support must occur as a distinct query plane in that subtree. No conclusion on survivors.
